cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says the platform is in service. UCL IIPP's DPI Map lists a data exchange system as implemented (checked October 2024), but names no bodies connected, and the ministry's October 2026 workshop was still planning an X-Road pilot.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-13 on DPI Map's line that a data exchange system is implemented (checked October 2024): the ministry's October 2026 workshop planning an X-Road pilot is newer and from a primary, so it stands. Nothing says a platform carries data between public bodies.
